name: Android CLI
description: Gives coding agents and scripts one command-line entry point to set up the Android SDK, scaffold, build, and run apps, manage devices, and profile performance.

skills.name: Set Up SDK And Scaffold Projects
skills.description: Automates Android SDK and environment setup and scaffolds new projects from templates.

skills.name: Build And Run On Devices
skills.description: Builds, installs, and runs apps on connected devices or emulators, manages virtual devices, and inspects live screens and UI hierarchies.

skills.name: Render Compose Previews
skills.description: Renders Jetpack Compose previews to images on your machine, with no device or Android Studio required.

skills.name: Profile And Analyze Apps
skills.description: Records system traces and heap dumps, and reports APK and app bundle sizes, R8 optimization metrics, and keep rule warnings.

skills.name: Investigate Field Crashes
skills.description: Investigates crashes, ANRs, and non-fatal issues that Firebase Crashlytics reports for your app, including out-of-memory heap dumps.
